verdict.rationale: A lockfile format is a fair question for a package manager, so the axis applies. The evidence pack mentions flakes (`nix flake new`, `nix build`) but never documents a lockfile, its text format, or any way for an agent to read or diff it. Flake commands alone are adjacent and do not establish a documented lockfile format.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at a documented, text-based lockfile format it can read and diff
